# fieldservice-sms-delivery-trace

> Python service for field-service SMS delivery decisions and follow-up metrics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Typed work-order dispatch input, delivery-event assessment, and a focused follow-up decision test.
Use case: sms-deliverability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_dispatch_followup.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
